intended_use: Sproto Fighter Trenches stage fight theme (all Trenches levels and maps, Story and Level Select), seamless loop
notes: Post-processed from trenches_fight_raw.mp3. Source region is 24 bars at 128 BPM plus a 30 ms overlap, snapped to zero crossings. Equal-power overlap-add of the tail into the head sits at the top of the musical audio, so a hard wrap of that region has no click or gap. The file is 45.048 s because the MP3 container keeps encoder priming and one frame of padding. A decoder that drops the priming (Chrome decodeAudioData, ffmpeg) returns 45.000979 s, with 14 extra samples at the end. A decoder that keeps the priming has 1105 samples of delay at the head. Loop the musical 45.000687 s and leave both paddings outside the loop.
